items.q: What does your house cleanout service include?
a: Our house cleanout service includes removing furniture, appliances, electronics, clothing, trash, and other unwanted items from all areas of your home, including basements, attics, and garages. We also handle sorting, hauling, and responsible disposal, leaving your home clean and ready to use.

items.q: Do you remove hazardous materials from house cleanouts?
a: No, we do not handle hazardous materials such as chemicals, paints, oils, or asbestos. For safety reasons, these require specialized disposal. We can guide you to the proper local services that handle hazardous waste.

items.q: How quickly can you complete a house cleanout?
a: Most house cleanouts are completed within 1–3 hours, depending on the size of the home and the amount of junk to be removed. We also offer same-day and next-day services for urgent cleanouts.

items.q: Do you charge extra for heavy items or large furniture?
a: No, our pricing is upfront and all-inclusive. Whether it’s a couch, refrigerator, or bulky bed, we include it in your quote so there are no hidden fees or surprises later.

items.q: Can you help me sort through my items during a house cleanout?
a: Yes, we can help you sort through items if needed. Our team is patient and respectful, making sure you decide what stays and what goes. We’ll then handle all the lifting, hauling, and disposal for you.
